newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bomb wounds 20 in Algerian cafe.
newsitem.headline: Bomb wounds 20 in Algerian cafe.

text.p: A bomb exploded in Algiers on Sunday, wounding 20 people and bringing the toll from bombings in the capital to at least 18 dead and nearly 180 wounded in such attacks in under one week.
Algerian security forces, in a statement carried on the official news agency APS, said the bomb went off at around 10.30 a.m. (0930 GMT) in the southern suburb of El Harrach.
The earlier attacks were blamed on Moslem fundamentalists.
Witnesses said the bomb exploded in a cafe in the main square of the working class suburb.
